search_window.basis: Start is the completed_at timestamp of the latest verified prior hourly Food Line heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger, converted to America/Los_Angeles. Search-index recency alone does not establish a new disruption.

coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch, not primary nationwide Food Line collection. Primary production collection remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches completed across four high-value categories: sole/last/full-service grocery loss (3); canceled emergency food distribution (3); abrupt pantry/food-bank closure/access reduction (3); immediate official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption (3). All web search requests returned; no transport error observed.

No newly source-dated, verifiable qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found within the latest verified heartbeat interval. Search-index recency mismatches and local-source indexing gaps limit sensitivity; this is not proof of nationwide absence.
